sync-stray-brace.why: the wasm server publishes an empty diagnostics list for the text's version (raw publishDiagnostics captured: `diagnostics: []`), also with the brace there from the start (no resume), while native `satex lint` of the same text reports C013 `Too many }'s` at 8:18: the client shows what it gets

tc-type-begin-arg.owner: server (Rust: environment effects for the echo) + Type-mode echo
tc-type-begin-arg.why: the echo no longer prints the environment's name, but sets \begin{center} Quokka \end{center} on the row typed in, while TeX starts a centred row a \topsep lower: the caret jumps ~50 px as the build lands. A fix without a name table needs the run to report, per environment name, what its begin code leaves: the vertical space it adds (\topsep, \partopsep, \parskip as \@trivlist adds them, ltlists.dtx) and the paragraph shape it sets (\leftskip, \rightskip, \parfillskip: \centering's 0pt plus 1fil), e.g. in the page view's run lengths or a satex/envEffect query

tc-type-begin-enter.owner: server (Rust: environment effects for the echo) + Type-mode echo
tc-type-begin-enter.why: the same root as tc-type-begin-arg: the echo sets the environment's body on the row typed in, TeX a centred row a \topsep lower

tc-type-align-loads.why: the exports index records only names defined as a control sequence (`\def\align`, amstex.sty), never an environment defined by a braced name (`\newenvironment{align}`, amsmath.sty): align is offered with `\usepackage{amstex}`, which is obsolete and errors; then the echo's environment row (tc-type-begin-arg); the echo of a display's body (x typed into align or equation, no load needed) stays after the build has it, so the page never settles

tc-type-load-keeps-caret.why: x lands (the check this scenario guards); the build fails on the \usepackage{amstex} the exports index offers for align (tc-type-align-loads) and the echo's environment row jumps (tc-type-begin-arg); the echo of a display's body (x typed into align or equation, no load needed) stays after the build has it, so the page never settles

table-nested-edit.owner: main session: wasm rebuild with widgets land-03 (src/lsp/tabular.rs nested env)
table-nested-edit.match: ^(Apply after a cell edit wrote nothing|after the edit:)
table-nested-edit.why: the playground's wasm parses a tabular nested in a cell as two outer rows (fixed natively in land-03, lsp::tabular::tests::a_nested_tabular_is_one_cell); the dialog then shows a bogus row 3, Enter after an edit pads it, and Apply writes nothing

enter-in-list.why: Enter on an item's line writes the next \item (source right), but the echo sets the typed item's words on the row typed in, not as a new item a row lower with its label: the caret jumps when the build lands

listing.why: a listing typed into from the PDF: the echo measures its row in the text font, the landed build's glyphs sit up to 6 px left, so the caret jumps on landing (the click and the typing work since 2026-11-21: verbatim characters are no macro output)

u-table-add-col-while-editing.why: table widget: + (column at the end) while a cell is being edited throws NotFoundError replaceChildren (blur handler); the column is not added

u-tikz-drag-node-text.why: Type mode on (default): a drag that starts on a node's text does nothing, no move, no ghost, no selection
